en.headline: Hongkong Land lights up Statue Square with Halloween installations through month end
en.dek: Four large free installations, including a giant eyeball over the fountain, illuminate nightly until 31 October as part of the Central event.
body: Hongkong Land is running Halloween in Central from 17 to 31 October, with four large-scale installations at Statue Square Gardens South that light up every evening and are free to visit.

The centrepiece is a giant eyeball installation rising above the fountain. Other pieces include a monumental gateway at the Chater Road entrance, a coffin throne near a Central MTR exit, and a reimagining of the pavilion as a haunted jail. Lighting runs from 4pm to 11.30pm each night, and until 1am on 31 October, according to the organisers.

Chater Road hosts themed days on selected dates, including a family carnival on 24 October and a street event on Halloween night. The overall programme is supported by the Hong Kong Tourism Board. Installations remain accessible during the day, with the evening illumination creating the main visual focus.
The event is one of several Halloween Month activities across the city organised or supported by the Tourism Board in partnership with local venues.

zh.headline: 置地公司於皇后像廣場設置萬聖裝置至月底
zh.dek: 包括噴水池旁巨型眼球在內的四個大型免費裝置每晚亮燈，活動至10月31日。
body: 置地公司由10月17日至31日在中環舉辦「萬聖狂歡祭．中環」，於皇后像廣場花園（南）設置四個大型裝置，每晚亮燈，免費參觀。
焦點是噴水池旁升起的巨型眼球裝置。其他包括遮打道入口的巨型拱門、中環港鐵站出口附近的棺木寶座，以及將涼亭改造成鬼魅監獄。主辦方指，每晚4時至11時30分亮燈，10月31日延長至凌晨1時。
遮打道在選定日期舉行主題活動，包括10月24日親子嘉年華及萬聖節當日的街頭活動。整體項目獲香港旅遊發展局支持。裝置日間亦可參觀，晚上亮燈為主要視覺焦點。
這是旅發局與本地場地合作舉辦或支持的多項萬聖月活動之一。
